set.body: From the cold review of S0 (finding F3). Anchoring uses the whole record's start/end. A record spanning 0-10000 s binds a 9000 s target. Real ASR items are complete decoder segments whose ownership note says words outside the target are context, yet quoting those outside words still binds. Link reached: permits, not occurs. Measure how many frozen proofs bind only through outside-target words before choosing a fix (word timings exist in the ASR source).
set.title: [evidence-binding] Target overlap is checked per record, not per quoted span
